Welcome to LaunchFleet 🚀

Manage what apps and services start with your Mac.

  • ✓ See all startup items in one place
  • ✓ Toggle items on/off with one click
  • ✓ Identify orphaned and high-impact items
  • ✓ User-level items: no password needed
  • ✓ System items: one authorization for the whole session
  • ✓ Removals go to a quarantine you can restore from

By default, only your user-level items can be modified. Click System Mode if you also want to manage system-wide daemons.
